description: This file defines the Zend_Http_UserAgent class, which manages user agent detection, configuration, and serialization within the Zend Framework. It includes constants for default values, methods for setting and retrieving server variables, plugin loaders, and device detection logic based on user agent strings.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent
classes.description: A class for detecting and managing user agent information, including configuration, device detection, serialization, and plugin loader management.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns a serialized string representation of the UserAgent object, including device info and server data.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Restores the UserAgent object state from a serialized string, instantiating the device object as needed.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Configures the UserAgent object with an options array or Zend_Config object.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Returns the device object representing the detected device characteristics.

methods.name: getUserAgent
methods.description: Retrieves the user agent string from server data or default.

methods.name: setUserAgent
methods.description: Sets the user agent string in server data.

methods.name: getHttpAccept
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP Accept header value.

methods.name: setHttpAccept
methods.description: Sets the HTTP Accept header value.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage handler, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Assigns a storage handler.

methods.name: clearStorage
methods.description: Clears stored user agent info from persistent storage.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration array.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration with provided options.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Retrieves the server variables array.

methods.name: setServer
methods.description: Sets the server variables array.

methods.name: getServerValue
methods.description: Returns a specific server variable value.

methods.name: setServerValue
methods.description: Sets a specific server variable value.

methods.name: setPluginLoader
methods.description: Assigns a plugin loader for a specific type ('storage', 'device').

methods.name: getPluginLoader
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin loader for a specific type, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: _matchUserAgent
methods.description: Runs for each sequence to identify the right user agent device type based on the user agent string.

methods.name: _createDevice
methods.description: Instantiates the device object based on the detected browser type.
